text:
B: Hello.
A: Hiya. Joanne.
B: Shazia.
A: Where are you?
B: Blackburn.
A: St Helens, me.
B: Mm.
A: Erm, are you working? I'm not. I look after me mum.
B: No. Not working. My back. I was in a warehouse, packing.
A: I was in a warehouse. Food packing, Haydock. Eleven years.
B: Nights?
A: Days, mostly. Some lates. You?
B: Nights. It weren't good for me. My nerves and that. I couldn't sleep in the day.
A: No. I don't sleep much now anyway. I lie there thinking she's fallen or wandered off. She's got dementia. Lives four streets away. I've thought about one of them alarms, but she takes the pendant off and puts it in a drawer. So every morning I'm round there first thing, before I've even had a brew, just to check she's still there and she's had her tablets. Then I come back, walk round the park, go back again. That's my day, really.
B: My mum's three streets.
A: Is she poorly?
B: Her knees. She can't do the stairs proper. My brother lives with her, but I go every day. I do her eyebrows, cook a bit, sit with her and my aunties.
A: At least your brother's there. My sister's in Warrington and I do it all.
B: Brothers don't do much, mind. His wife does.
A: Ha. That sounds about right.
B: Yeah.
A: Erm. That puzzle at the start. Did you get on alright?
B: Some. The shapes ones I didn't.
A: No. Me neither. I like a word search. That was something else.
B: I do colouring books sometimes. Not puzzles.
A: Do you do the surveys, then? That's how I found this.
B: Yeah. For vouchers. Imran said it's a scam.
A: Gary said that. He said, they'll want your bank details next.
B: They all say that.
A: They do. Is Imran your husband?
B: Yeah. Taxi.
A: Gary's a delivery driver. Never home before Christmas.
B: Imran's out Friday and Saturday all night. Then he sleeps all Sunday.
A: Mm.
B: You got kids?
A: No. No, we haven't.
B: Me neither.
A: Right. Erm, have you got a cat or anything? I've got Mabel. She's sick on the settee every other day.
B: No. Just plants. On the windowsill. They don't do much.
A: At least they're not sick on the settee.
B: No. That's true. My mum says I should get a...
